summary: The article accurately reports on PhonePe's new inactivity fee, its conditions, and ways to avoid it, aligning with information from multiple financial news outlets.

claims.claim: PhonePe has introduced a ₹100 quarterly inactivity fee for wallets that have not recorded any financial transaction for 365 consecutive days.
claims.note: Multiple sources confirm the ₹100 quarterly fee for wallets inactive for 365 days.

claims.claim: This fee will be deducted directly from the existing wallet balance, though the balance will not go into negative territory.
claims.note: Sources confirm the fee deduction from the wallet balance and that it will not result in a negative balance.

claims.claim: Merely logging into the app or performing UPI transactions will not count as wallet activity to reset the inactivity clock.
claims.note: Multiple sources explicitly state that only wallet-based financial transactions count as activity.

claims.claim: Users will receive a 15-day notice before the fee is deducted, providing an opportunity to reactivate the wallet.
claims.note: Sources confirm a 15-day advance notice will be sent to users.

claims.claim: The PhonePe inactivity fee is applicable from June 2026.
claims.note: Multiple articles published in June 2026 discuss the fee as a recent or upcoming change, effective from June 2026.

claims.claim: Other fintech players like MobiKwik and Airtel Payments Bank have also implemented similar inactivity or maintenance charges for dormant wallets in the past.
claims.note: Sources confirm that MobiKwik introduced inactivity charges in 2021 and Airtel Payments Bank also has similar fees.

article_title: PhonePe Inactivity Fee: Avoid the ₹100 Quarterly Charge
